description: Trigger evals for devrites-debug-recovery — systematic recovery when tests/build/typecheck/runtime/browser checks go red, vs sibling phases and bundled debug/review/interview/tdd/prototype/handoff skills.

queries.text: Debug this — the tests just started failing.
queries.rationale: Direct 'debug this' + failing tests is the core trigger.

queries.text: Why is this failing all of a sudden?
queries.rationale: 'why is it failing' trigger phrase.

queries.text: It broke after my last commit — find out what happened.
queries.rationale: 'it broke' trigger phrase.

queries.text: The build is red, figure out what's wrong.
queries.rationale: 'the build is red' trigger phrase.

queries.text: The tests fail now and I don't know why.
queries.rationale: 'the tests fail' trigger phrase.

queries.text: CI went red after the merge — track down the cause and fix it.
queries.rationale: Paraphrase of a red check needing root-cause recovery.

queries.text: The typecheck is throwing errors I can't explain.
queries.rationale: Typecheck failure is an in-scope red check.

queries.text: The page throws an exception in the browser at runtime — find the root cause.
queries.rationale: Runtime/browser check failure, in-scope.

queries.text: Give me a few ranked hypotheses for why this keeps erroring, then fix the real cause.
queries.rationale: Oblique but matches the ranked-hypotheses + root-cause method.

queries.text: Reproduce this failure and get to the root cause instead of patching the symptom.
queries.rationale: Reproduce + fix root cause is the skill's cycle.

queries.text: Something's broken in the build — can you debug it?
queries.rationale: Direct ask: broken build + debug.

queries.text: The slice's tests went red on completion; I need a systematic debug, not shotgun edits.
queries.rationale: Build/prove failure context demanding disciplined recovery.

queries.text: Build the next vertical slice of this feature.
queries.rationale: /rite-build owns implementing a slice.

queries.text: Run the full test suite and prove the feature works end-to-end.
queries.rationale: /rite-prove owns running the full suite for evidence.

queries.text: This query got 5x slower after the upgrade — diagnose the performance regression.
queries.rationale: diagnose owns performance regressions, not a red-check failure.

queries.text: Grill me on my fix plan before I touch the code.
queries.rationale: grill-me owns stress-testing a plan via interview.

queries.text: Give my pull request a code review.
queries.rationale: code-review owns reviewing a diff for bugs and cleanups.

queries.text: Build this feature test-first using red-green-refactor.
queries.rationale: tdd owns the red-green-refactor build loop.

queries.text: Mock up a few throwaway UI designs so I can play with them.
queries.rationale: prototype owns throwaway design exploration.

queries.text: Compact our conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
queries.rationale: handoff owns conversation compaction for handoff.
